headline: President Clinton amended an earlier order that sets how federal agencies run U.S. overseas food aid programs.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 12752, which assigns duties for carrying out two food aid laws: the Agricultural Trade Development and Assistance Act of 1954 (often called Food for Peace) and the Food for Progress Act of 1985. These programs send U.S. farm products to other countries. The title does not say exactly what was changed. It likely adjusts which agencies handle which tasks.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run food aid programs
who_it_affects.how: Their roles or duties in managing overseas food aid may be changed by this order.
